message: You know that friend who panics at the slightest bump in the road? We all have one! Well, when it comes to power outages, I’ve learned that staying calm and prepared can make all the difference. I found this helpful resource from the Red Cross that breaks down how to handle those unexpected blackouts. It’s all about having a game plan and keeping a level head—because who wants to be the panicked one in the dark, right? What’s your go-to tip for staying calm during a power outage?
